rows.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft reference and origin page
rows.detail: Germinal products becomes a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products beside it, with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, routing and set services. Its journey pages use the live-animals slugs under the germinal mount, each a copy of its live-animals page plus the germinal differences. Every answer the live-animals set asks is carried over except the two the notification data specification marks for the animals journey alone, the county parish holding number and the permanent address, so the germinal set has neither page. This row lays the set down and proves it with its first page: starting a germinal notification creates a draft with the same kind of reference a live-animals notification gets, the status strip names the category beside the reference, and the trader lands on the set's own copy of the origin page, which asks the four origin answers the live-animals page asks. The set's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit in the animals test project, and the high-risk plants journey gets no germinal pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification from the germinal set's own start creates a notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, and lands on the set's page headed 'Origin of the import'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-102, -p1-103, -p1-104)
From the first germinal page the status strip reads 'Draft' then 'Germinal products - ' followed by the notification's reference. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-102)
Every germinal products notification's reference begins GBN-AG. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

A germinal products notification's journey pages are reached at /germinal-products/notifications/<journeyId>/<slug>, under the same slugs the live-animals set uses, and each page saves its answers against that notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-001, -p1-002, -p1-006, -p1-007, -p1-009, -p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015)

The germinal set's origin page asks for the country of origin, whether a region of origin code is required, the region of origin code and the internal reference number, with the same hints, options and error messages as the live-animals origin page, and saves all four against the germinal notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-077, -p5-078; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-103, -p1-104)

Opening the county parish holding number or permanent address slug under a germinal notification shows the page not found page; every other germinal page asks the answers its live-animals twin asks. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-001, -p5-072, -p5-076, -p5-077, -p5-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015, -p3-022)

The germinal journey's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs run in the animals test project the live-animals journey already uses, under germinal products folders of the e2e, a11y and security test types, and no new test project is added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-061, -p1-062, -p1-063; repo:tests repo-tests-p10-151, repo-tests-p11-038, repo-tests-p11-088)

The accessibility specs walk the germinal pages built so far and hold each to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the accessibility suite's existing rules, and the security scan drives the germinal routes. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063)
The high-risk plants journey has no germinal pages and no germinal set: its pages and its journey are unchanged. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)
rows.gate: Look at the germinal set's skeleton (its mount, routing, set services, status strip wording and its copied origin page) before the other germinal page copies follow it: every later germinal row copies a live-animals feature folder into this set the same way.
notes: existingRow inc-176: this area's share of the germinal set's skeleton row; the combiner keeps its id, theme, gate, dependencies and external dependencies, and merges the other areas' drafts of it (the stored category, the cross-set guard, the service chrome and the outbox envelope, which bring the backend repo in).
Re-distil: none of this area's four requirements changed since the last distil; the criteria are carried over as they stand.

The strip reference comes from the shared kit's journey strip. If the plan finds the shared kit or layout must change, that change belongs on the split-off journey-foundation branch and this row consumes it, so frontend:src/server/app/shared is listed as shared, not touched.
The type question's Germinal products option is the split-off type-question-and-templates theme's, so this row answers the start it posts to rather than building the option.

rows.title: The germinal set's 'What are you importing?' page offers germinal commodities only, with its own search hint
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of 'What are you importing?' keeps the live-animals page as it stands and changes only its search hint, which tells the trader they can search for semen, ova or embryos. Each set holds one category, so the germinal page's search offers germinal-product commodities alone and never a live-animal commodity. The page searches the commodity data the service has, through the Search button the live page already has, so it works with or without JavaScript. What the catalogue holds is the central reference data's content, not this row's: the page offers whatever germinal commodities are there, with the names and codes they carry.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal 'What are you importing?' page keeps the live-animals title, caption, heading, field label, buttons, Cancel link and back link to the origin page, and shows the inset 'You must submit a separate notification for every single health certificate. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an health certificate.' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-105; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Its search hint reads 'You can search for semen, ova or embryos, or by common name (for example, cattle), Latin name (Bos taurus) or commodity code (05119985).' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-106; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-017)
Continuing from the germinal 'What are you importing?' page with nothing selected shows 'Select a commodity' in the error summary. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-107)

The germinal page's search offers germinal-product commodities only: searching 'cattle' on a germinal notification lists germinal cattle commodities and no live-animal commodity. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-025, -p1-026, -p1-110; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-018, -p2-019; c-222)

The germinal page offers the germinal commodities the commodity data holds under 05111000 and 05119985, with the names and codes that data carries, each result showing its species, and embryos and ova appear as one combined line while the data holds them combined. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, -p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-010, -p2-016, -p2-019; c-282)

Searching on the germinal page happens through the page's Search button, with JavaScript on and with it off: typing alone shows no results, and typing 'semen' then pressing Search lists the semen commodities. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-010, -p2-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-109; c-382)
openQuestions: A germinal-only commodity search needs a change in trade-imports-reference-data, whose commodity search drops germinal codes today and offers no germinal equivalent, and the split-off reference-lists theme owns all of that repo's source, so no remaining theme may touch it. Default: build this row's frontend half against a germinal search the reference data serves, and either add that endpoint as a small change outside this backlog or widen the reference-lists pointer at a re-distil; the criteria here are observed against it either way.
notes: existingRow inc-016: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependency on the germinal skeleton row and external dependencies.
Re-distil: none of the three requirements changed since the last distil; the criteria are carried over as they stand.

Combines the page copy and hint (req-069), the one-category search (req-092) and today's germinal lines (req-1927): one page copy, proven by one germinal search. req-093 and req-1782 stay out of scope (c-282, c-382), so no criterion states a count or an order of germinal commodities.
Stands alone: it carries the reference-data open question the other germinal rows do not.

rows.title: The germinal start and its main import reason: two reasons, four purposes, the Transit answers and no exit date
rows.detail: A germinal products notification is started from the germinal set's own start, which creates the draft without asking the notification type question and opens at the set's origin page; from there the trader runs through 'What are you importing?' and the main import reason to Commodity details as live animals does. The germinal copy of the main import reason page offers only Internal market and Transit, each with a hint worded for consignments rather than animals; Internal market reveals only the four purposes, each with its germinal hint, and Transit reveals the same port of exit and destination country answers the live-animals set asks. The germinal set asks no exit date: the live-animals set keeps its own. A reason or purpose outside the lists the page offers is never saved.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Create new' on the germinal set's own notification list creates a germinal products draft without asking the notification type question and lands on the germinal page headed 'Origin of the import', which shows only 'Save and continue' and whose back link returns to that list. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-103, -p1-104; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-012, -p1-048, -p1-102, -p1-109; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, -p3-104, -p3-108, -p3-109; c-227, c-281)

From the germinal origin page the journey runs on through 'What are you importing?' and the main import reason to Commodity details, as the live-animals journey does. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-113, -p1-124; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The germinal page headed 'Main import reason' offers only Internal market and Transit, in that order, and ends with 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview'; its other wording is the live-animals page's. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-114; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; c-228)

On the germinal page Internal market has the hint 'For consignments intended for sale or use in Great Britain (England, Scotland or Wales).' and Transit has the hint 'For consignments moving through Great Britain for direct travel to a third country, that will enter Great Britain at one port or airport and leave from a different one within England, Scotland or Wales.' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-115, -p1-116)

Choosing Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market', offering only Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Research and Production, in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-117; c-228)

The four germinal purposes have these hints: Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift 'Any movement of a consignment that has as its aim the sale of or the transfer of ownership of the consignment from one person or entity to another.'; Breeding 'Consignments for reproduction. This includes animals and germinal products intended to contribute to the genetic pool of a breeding program, improve livestock quality, or produce offspring.'; Research 'Animals and germinal products for use in scientific or medical research.'; Production 'Animals and germinal products that are farmed for the production of meat, milk, eggs, wool or any other animal product or by-product.' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-118, -p1-119, -p1-120, -p1-121)

Saving Internal market with no purpose, or with a purpose outside those four, shows 'Select a purpose in the internal market', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-122; c-228)

Choosing Transit reveals 'Port of exit' then 'Destination country', in that order, each a select offering the same list with the same 'Select one' placeholder as the live-animals set and each labelled with no hint; saving with both unanswered shows 'Select a port of exit' then 'Select a destination country' in the error summary, and each message inline on its field. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-114, -p1-123; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-057, -p1-064)

The germinal main import reason page's further questions are the purpose under Internal market and the port of exit and destination country under Transit, and these are the only consignment-leaving questions any germinal page asks; the live-animals main import reason page keeps its exit date question. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005, -p1-006, -p1-007; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-114; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-078; c-331)

Saving a main reason outside Internal market and Transit, such as Re-entry, saves no reason: reopening the page shows nothing chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-114; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005)
notes: existingRow inc-024: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and external dependencies, and merges the reason-and-additional-details area's and the cross-area pass's drafts of this row (the reveals, the page's frame and the valid answer going on to Commodity details).
Re-distil: none of this area's twelve requirements changed since the last distil; the criteria are carried over as they stand.

c-281 (ruled): the INS germinal list's 'Create new' is not built here, so the set's own list starts a germinal notification. c-227 and c-228 (ruled): the set starts from its own route under the live-animals slugs, and its two reasons and four purposes always apply. c-331 (ruled): no exit date in the germinal set; the live-animals set keeps its own, and the criterion names the questions the page asks rather than the one it leaves out.
The type question's Germinal products option is the split-off type-question-and-templates theme's, so this row owns only the start it posts to.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details asks the quantity, the total gross weight and the temperature, the record holds them, and every trade line says what it is
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Commodity details asks, for each chosen species, a required quantity in units or pieces and an optional total gross weight in kilograms, and it always asks one optional temperature for the whole page. Germinal species are counted by quantity, never by head. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, and its block is headed by the commodity's name and code. The animals backend holds the quantity and the gross weight on each species line, the weight as a decimal, and the one temperature answer on every commodity line, and shows them back. Each published trade line's quantity is its quantity in units or pieces; the weight and the temperature are not published, because the profile the service publishes against carries no field for either. Each germinal trade line carries a type code taken from its product type, and while the commodity data still holds a combined embryos-and-ova line, that line records its ova as embryos.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal species block on Commodity details asks 'Total gross weight', after 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' and any 'Number of packages', in a narrow text input with the suffix 'kg', on every germinal species block whatever its commodity; left blank it shows no error and saves. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-007, -p5-008, -p5-010, -p5-012; c-022, c-231, c-232)

Each germinal species block on Commodity details asks 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' for that species alone, in a text field with no hint, and a germinal species block asks for no number of animals. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-013, -p5-015, -p5-016, -p5-019, -p5-021; c-234)

The germinal Commodity details page always asks one 'Temperature' radio question for the whole page, with the options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen in that order; left unanswered it shows no error and saves. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-023 to -p5-030; c-228, c-232, c-233)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Bos taurus'; its block is headed by the commodity's name followed by its code in brackets, such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)', and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-110; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002)

Ticking a germinal species, such as Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under Cattle, Semen, shows '1 selected' with a 'Cattle, Semen (05111000):' line and a remove button named 'Remove Domestic cattle (Bos taurus)', as the live-animal search does. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-112; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014; c-282)

A quantity, a total gross weight such as 24.50 and a temperature saved on germinal Commodity details are shown again when the page is reopened; the quantity and the weight are held on that species line, the weight in kilograms as a decimal, and the one temperature answer is held on every commodity line of the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-022, -p1-040, -p1-042; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-003, -p1-004; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-009, -p5-013, -p5-024; c-022, c-231, c-233, c-234)

In the notification published for a germinal products notification each trade line's quantity is that species line's quantity in units or pieces, and the payload carries only fields the gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 profile defines, so it carries no gross weight and no temperature. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040 to -p1-043; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-013; c-022, c-234)

In that published payload a semen trade line carries the type code SEMEN and a combined embryos-and-ova trade line carries EMBRYO, taken from the product type stored on the line. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-026, -p2-027, -p2-028; c-273, c-282)

In the published payload a germinal trade line whose stored product type is semen carries the type code SEMEN, one whose product type is embryos carries EMBRYO, and one whose product type is ova carries OVA. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036, -p1-037, -p1-038, -p1-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029; c-273)

A notification holding an embryos commodity and an ova commodity publishes them as two trade lines, each carrying its own type code. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036, -p1-037, -p1-038; c-282)

sources.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table b48994db9c1f rows 1 to 3 (confluence-6497338582-p5-004 to -p5-031)

openQuestions: The interim EMBRYO code for a combined embryos-and-ova line rests on nobody objecting rather than an active approval (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029). Default: build EMBRYO, so a combined line submitted before the commodity data separates them records its ova as embryos.
notes: existingRow inc-017: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and external dependencies, and merges the other areas' drafts of this row (the optional number of packages and its check, the page's frame and the temperature question's place, germinal publishing on today's profile and the live-animal type code).

Re-distil: none of this area's eight requirements changed since the last distil; the criteria are carried over, keeping only this area's. The number of packages criterion belongs to the commodities area's requirement in the same row.

c-022, c-231, c-232, c-233 (ruled): the answer is a total gross weight held per species line in kilograms; weight and temperature are optional; temperature is asked once and held on every line. c-234 (ruled): the quantity in units or pieces is the line's one required count and its published quantity. c-282: the catalogue's content is the central reference data's, so the quantity and the weight are asked on every germinal species block, and the type code is written by product type so a separate ova commodity takes OVA as soon as the data holds one.

Publishing is observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload and on the local stack's outbox, in every environment the row builds in; nothing reaches a real downstream system from a local stack and no criterion asks it to.

Combines the Commodity details questions (req-121, req-123, req-124, req-125), the selection read-out (req-1783), the record (req-122) and the type codes (req-1800, req-1928): one page, one commodity line, one publishing mapper.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks the quantity and the weight
rows.detail: The germinal set's Commodity details page checks the figures it asks for. The quantity is required and must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000. A total gross weight, when given, must be a number greater than 0, at most 1,000 kilograms and to no more than two decimal places, with spaces around the figure ignored. Each error is linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline, with what was entered kept.
acceptanceCriteria: A total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0 or 'abc', shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the 'There is a problem' error summary to that species' field and shown inline after the 'Error:' prefix, with what was entered kept in the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-109, -p3-115; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-053, -p4-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-040, -p1-125, -p1-126; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005)
A total gross weight with spaces around it, such as ' 24.50 ', saves as 24.50. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-110)

A total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 itself saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-011; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-060)

A total gross weight of 12.5 or 24.50 saves; one with more than two decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-009, -p5-011; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-055; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)
A blank quantity shows 'Enter the quantity', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown above it. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-017, -p5-074; c-234)

A quantity that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', in the error summary and above that species' field, linked to it. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-020, -p5-022; c-234)

A quantity over 1,000 shows 'Quantity must be 1,000 or less', linked to that species' field and shown above it; 1,000 itself saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-014, -p5-018, -p5-021; c-234)

rows.title: Germinal identification asks once per species for the donor, the dates and the identification number
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified once per species, whatever its quantity. The germinal set's copy of Identification details shows each chosen species one editable form, headed by the species name with no count, prefilled with what was saved, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. The form asks for a donor name or identification, a collection date, a production date and an identification number or mark, in that order, and asks for none of the live-animal identifiers. The panel keeps the species heading and its link back to Commodity details, worded for commodities, since the germinal set asks no number of animals. Valid germinal Commodity details lead here.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid germinal Commodity details continue to the page titled 'Identification details - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and headed 'Identification details'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-041, -p2-045; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-055; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Each germinal species panel keeps its species heading and a 'Change number of commodities' link to Commodity details, whose visually hidden suffix names the panel as the live-animals link's does. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-125; ruling:ian-2026-11-11 ruling-ian-2026-11-11-p1-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; c-520)

Each germinal species shows one editable form headed 'Enter details for <species>' with no count, such as 'Enter details for Bos taurus', whatever its quantity, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-034, -p5-062; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-064; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-046, -p1-047, -p1-057)

The form asks 'Donor name/ID' (text), 'Collection date', 'Production date' and 'Identification number/mark' (text), in that order, on every germinal species panel whatever its commodity. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-032, -p5-039, -p5-041, -p5-049, -p5-051, -p5-059, -p5-060, -p5-067, -p5-069, -p5-075; c-230)

Those four are the only answers the germinal identification page asks: it asks for no ear tag, passport, microchip, tattoo or horse name. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-110; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-001, -p5-076, -p5-077; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138)

The values typed into each germinal species' form are saved by the page's 'Save and continue' and by its 'Save and return to overview', and are shown prefilled when the page is opened again. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-046, -p1-047; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-034, -p5-062)

notes: existingRow inc-052: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and external dependency, and merges the animal-identification area's draft (the 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' column heading), the notification-record area's draft (the four answers stored, dates as date-only values, and left out of the published payload) and the caption requirement.

Re-distil: the panel link's wording changed. c-520 (ruled) keeps the prototype the authority on how the page reads, so the germinal panel's link reads 'Change number of commodities', with the live link's hidden suffix; the criterion that kept the live-animals wording is rewritten. The other four requirements are unchanged.

The backend repo stays because saving the four answers needs a home on the record; where they sit is the build's call from the real model, so no criterion names a field or class. If the build puts them on the per-item identifier entries it edits code the split-off identification-and-permanent-address theme owns, and the germinal-products theme already lands after it.

rows.title: Germinal identification dates and names: text inputs with a 'Choose date' calendar, the format, real-date and length checks, and both save buttons checking alike
rows.detail: On the germinal identification page the collection and production dates are each a single text input with an example hint, so the page works fully without JavaScript, and a 'Choose date' calendar sits over each input to enhance it. The donor name or identification and the identification number or mark are each capped at 58 characters, and each date must be given as a day, month and four-digit year and must be a real date. Nothing else is checked: any real date, past or future, is accepted, a one- or two-digit day and month are accepted, and the production date is never compared with the collection date. When several answers fail, the errors are listed in the order the fields are asked, each linked to its own field. On every germinal page that shows both save buttons, the two make exactly the same checks.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', and both can be typed in and saved with JavaScript turned off, reading back exactly as typed. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-042, -p5-052; c-283)

Each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle that opens a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close', and picking a day fills that date's text input with the day, month and four-digit year; it is the same Ministry of Justice calendar the live animals dates use, and with JavaScript off the text input still works on its own. (ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-014, -p1-039, -p1-040, -p1-042, -p1-043; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002, -p1-009 to -p1-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-044, -p1-045, -p1-092; c-283)

A donor name or ID over 58 characters shows 'Donor name/ID must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline on the field; 58 characters of any kind save. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-033, -p5-037, -p5-040, -p5-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

An identification number or mark over 58 characters shows 'Identification number/mark must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline on the field; 58 characters of any kind save. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-061, -p5-065, -p5-068, -p5-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date not given as day/month/four-digit year, such as 2026-09-01, shows 'Enter a collection date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-043; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date not given as day/month/four-digit year, such as 2026-09-01, shows 'Enter a production date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-053; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date in the right form that is not a real date, such as 99/99/2026, shows 'Collection date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-043; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date in the right form that is not a real date, such as 31/02/2026, shows 'Production date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-053; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date of 1/9/2026, a collection date in the past, a collection date in the future, a production date in the past, a production date in the future and a production date earlier than the collection date all save with no error and read back exactly as entered. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-047, -p5-050, -p5-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A germinal identification save with several invalid answers re-renders the page with the error summary titled 'There is a problem' listing them in field order, Donor name/ID, Collection date, Production date then Identification number/mark, each linking to its own field, which is shown in error with its message inline after the 'Error:' prefix and keeps what was typed. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-125, -p1-126; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-032, -p5-041, -p5-051, -p5-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

On every germinal page that shows both buttons, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a missing or invalid answer keeps the trader on the page, shows an error in the summary and inline for each one, keeps what they entered and saves nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-011, -p1-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009, -p1-013, -p1-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; c-339)

On germinal Commodity details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a blank quantity, a total gross weight of 0 and a total gross weight over 1,000 shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-011, -p1-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On germinal Identification details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a donor name over 58 characters and a collection date that is not a real date shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-011, -p1-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On every germinal page that shows both buttons, with nothing missing or invalid 'Save and return to overview' saves the answers and shows the notification overview, while 'Save and continue' saves them and goes on. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009; c-339)
notes: existingRow inc-053: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and external dependency, and merges the animal-identification area's draft of this row (the same date and length rules, stated once per pair).
Re-distil: none of the eleven requirements changed since the last distil; the criteria are carried over as they stand.

c-283 (ruled): each date is a single text input that works without JavaScript, and the calendar enhances it. The Ministry of Justice date field is already shared code the live dates use, so this row reuses it and edits no shared file; its styles belong to the split-off design-snagging theme.

c-339 (ruled): the same-checks rule reaches every germinal page that shows both buttons. The Commodity details save-and-return criterion relies on the germinal Commodity details checks row, so this row lands after it and after the journey row whose pages it walks.
Stands alone from the identification questions row: together they would carry over 20 criteria.

rows.title: The germinal journey asks the live animals arrival questions and is certified for 'Germinal products' from the start
rows.detail: The germinal set's arrival details and transit countries pages are copies of their live-animals twins, asking the same questions in the same wording and order with the same rules, the transit countries page appearing only when the means of transport is rail or road. A trader importing germinal products is never asked what the consignment is certified for, because there is only one answer it can have: the draft is created holding 'Germinal products', with no way to change it.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal set's arrival details page asks the same five questions as the live-animals set, in the same wording and the same order and with the same rules. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-064; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-077, -p5-078; c-344)

On a germinal products notification whose means of transport is rail or road, the transit countries page follows arrival details and asks the same question as the live-animals set's; with any other means of transport arrival details goes on without it. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-064; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-116; c-344)

A germinal products draft is created holding 'Germinal products' as what the consignment is certified for, no germinal page asks it, and the germinal review shows 'Certified for' reading 'Germinal products' with no Change link. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p10-147)
notes: existingRow inc-182: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and external dependencies, and merges the journey-flow, notification-hub and reason-and-additional-details areas' drafts of this row (the overview, consignment addresses, status strip, journey buttons, the review's 'Certified for' row and its published clause).

Re-distil: neither requirement changed since the last distil. The transit countries criterion states req-2166's second half; if the germinal transit countries row (inc-283) already states the same rule, the combiner keeps it once there and req-2166 stays here.
c-344 (ruled): the germinal set asks for transit countries on the same terms as live animals.

No backend change is expected: the record already stores certified-for as free text, so the germinal set sets the value when it creates the draft, in its own start rather than the shared stub create lifecycle the split-off manage-notifications theme owns.

rows.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
rows.detail: The germinal set leaves the Additional details page out, because it never asks what the goods are certified for and no germinal commodity has unweaned options, so the overview's consignment section holds Commodity details, and Identification details where it applies, only, and a valid identification page reached through the journey leads straight on to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, so a partly or wholly blank entry saves without a missing-value error, but a selected germinal species counts as identified only once its entry holds at least one of the four identifiers, and that one bar decides both the overview's Complete status and whether the notification can be submitted. The identification page itself shows no message for the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview consignment section holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-057; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey shows Arrival details; opened from its overview task or from the review, the same button returns there. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank saves with no error summary and moves the trader on. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-003, -p5-036, -p5-046, -p5-056, -p5-064, -p5-074; c-041, c-235)

The overview's Identification details task shows Complete only once every selected germinal species, a lone species included, has at least one of the four identifiers saved. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-002; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, -p1-188, -p1-189; c-235, c-277)

Submitting a germinal notification with a selected species whose entry holds no identifier, a lone species included, is refused, and it submits once that species has one. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-002, -p5-003; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; c-235, c-277)
notes: existingRow inc-183: the combiner keeps its id, theme and dependencies.

Re-distil: neither requirement changed since the last distil. req-181 also names a return to the template review; templates are deferred (ruling:sam-2026-11-25) and their review is the split-off type-question-and-templates theme's, so no criterion here returns to a template's review, and that return is built with the template review when it is.
c-041, c-235 and c-277 (ruled): one identifier is enough, a blank entry still saves but does not count, and a lone germinal species is not exempt.
